description: Set independent width and height scale on a clip. Turns Uniform Scale off, writes Motion > Scale Width (width) and Motion > Scale (which Premiere uses as the height once Uniform Scale is off), then reads all three back. Fails when a value does not read back.

scale_height.description: Scale height percentage (0-10000). Written to Motion > Scale, which is the height when Uniform Scale is off.

name: set_scale_width_height

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Scale Width Height
